en: With me...
note: Player. Ends the inverted question in #8718/#8719 ('Like Princess Rowena, / would you have the courage to leave this house? / With me...').

en: ...Do you mean it,
note: Rose; the name + #537 '?' follow on the next line.

en: If you do...
I'd be so happy.
Here in London, I have something
that I must do, but...
Will you wait for me until it's done?
Of course...
I'll wait for you forever.
Even if I were a monster,
would you still come with me?
I don't care who or what you are.
So be sure to come for me.
You came for me?
Rose
Close your eyes...
It'll be over soon...
Someday, into my clan
I'll welcome you properly...
...Rose, I love you.
Master, command me as you wish...
I've felt strange since coming to London.
More fresh cuts, and no memory of my nights.
Bid me do anything at all...
I dreamed a monster chased me through the streets.
But I was a monster too. It frightens me.
Madam, is something the matter?
Oh, good morning.
Um... I've lost my way.
Oh? Where were you headed?
I may be able to help you.
I take it you're from abroad as well.
I came from Paris to see the sights.
I left the hotel for a little morning walk,
note: Shared with msg 341325, where slice 110 row #8830 follows: it must start lowercase.

en: and now I can't find my way back...
I have a map. I'll show you on it.
Thank you for your kindness.
You're such a kind person.
Good morning. We meet again.
It seems you live here.
London is such a lovely city.
I'd have liked to live here longer too.
My, what luck to run into you again.
I've enjoyed the sights and made a lovely
note: Cut before 'friend' to match #8839 (slice 110) 'I've enjoyed the sights and made a lovely young', which shares #8764.

en: friend, too. How lucky I am.
On your way to work, I suppose. Take care.
Madam. Is something wrong?
I only meant to stroll around a little,
note: Followed by #8754 (msg 340792) and #8842 (slice 110, msg 341466): #8842 must start lowercase.

en: Coming home from work? You must be tired.
London really is a wonderful city.
So pretty, so modern. If I were younger,
I'd have liked to really live here.
Good evening. A lovely night, isn't it?
The night breeze has its charm, too.
You're a curious one. Somehow you seem
more alive at night.
Hello. Um, could I trouble you a moment?
This is Big Ben, isn't it?
Yes, it is. No mistake.
Are you sightseeing?
Yes. Can you tell?
I'm from Paris.
London really is a big city. It amazes me.
Indeed. It's so big it makes my head spin.
I'm from abroad myself, you see.
Thank you so much. Good day.
Hello. We've met before, haven't we?
Is this the right place for Big Ben?
Yes, this right here is Big Ben.
Oh, good. I thought I'd gotten lost again.
Thanks to you, I'm enjoying my sightseeing.
Silly, isn't it? I came to see Big Ben
note: Shared with msg 341766, where slice 110 row #8866 follows: it must start with 'again.'

en: again. ...It's so big and lovely.
It's the symbol of London, after all.
If only I could take a photograph.
Oh my, you've caught me again.
Coming here has somehow become a habit.
I never tire of it, however often I look.
So you like Big Ben too.
Where should I go next, I wonder.
